subject: Request: Extended evaluation window & credits for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Gomez <s.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Extended evaluation window & credits for Nimbus Health

Team —

Quick background: Nimbus Health (Sara Gomez, Dir. of Product) reached out asking for a non-standard evaluation for a prospective deployment across two hospital systems. They want an 8-week hands-on pilot with our hosted inference (text generation + embeddings) and are asking for additional free credits to cover peak token use during live data tests.

Why this matters: Nimbus is evaluating for a multi-year contract across their telehealth and clinical search teams. Estimated initial ARR if successful: $420k. Their procurement timeline pushes for a longer POC so they can validate reliability under real traffic.

Request: My proposed ask to Deal Desk / Finance / Sales Ops — approval to grant an 8-week evaluation window (our standard is 14 days) and a one-time free credit top-up of $8,000 to cover test runs. Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_Draft.pdf (scoped), Nimbus_Security_QA.xlsx (answered security questions so far).

Criteria / safeguards I recommend if we approve:
- Limit: credits are one-time, non-recurring and expire at the pilot end date.
- Metrics: 2-week check-ins (product + CS) with usage and quality signals; automatic cut-off if abuse/suspicious patterns detected.
- Contract: simple MOU addendum signed by both sides confirming evaluation objectives, data handling, and a PO for implementation work (they will provide PO once commercial terms agreed).
- HubSpot: log exception and tie to DEAL-9876; require legal addendum for liability/security items.

Why $8k: Their anticipated token consumption for full test runs (including embedding of existing EHR snippets and several end-to-end scenarios) is ~1.8M tokens. $8k covers peak usage while giving them room to validate.

Ask: marissa/laura/karthik — can you approve the 8-week + $8k credit exception? If not, please propose an alternate cap or timeline. I need to respond to Sara by EOD Monday so we don't lose momentum.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_Draft.pdf (12 pages), Nimbus_Security_QA.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extended evaluation window & credits for Nimbus Health

Ben —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. I agree this is a strategic vertical and the ARR potential justifies a meaningful exception, but we should be pragmatic on exposure. My thoughts:

- Approve extension to 6 weeks and free credits up to $6,000 as a baseline exception we can grant quickly.
- Anything above $6k or beyond 6 weeks should require explicit finance/legal sign-off and a one-page MOU signed by Nimbus guaranteeing the scope and conversion checkpoints.
- Require that the CS lead (I recommend looping Laura’s team) sets two product validation milestones (week 2 and week 5) that trigger continued consumption.

If finance is comfortable, we can give full 8 weeks/$8k as a one-off with these conditions. Ben — please confirm if Nimbus can sign a short MOU and commit to the two check-ins. Also log the proposed exception in HubSpot against DEAL-9876.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Sales
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Folks —

Finance perspective: I can provisionally approve up to $5,000 of complimentary credits and a 6-week extension provided Legal signs off on the MOU addendum and Procurement provides a PO for any professional services work. For anything above $5k (or beyond 6 weeks) I need explicit executive approval outlining the ROI assumptions and risk acceptance. Please note:

- Accounting treatment: credits will be recorded as a marketing/promotional expense and need GL coding (we'll require a short internal form).
- Controls: we need to define hard token caps and an expiry date on the credits. No auto-conversion to paid usage beyond the agreed limits.
- Procurement notes: Nimbus must supply a PO for deployment work or we withhold certain integration tasks until the PO is received.

Ben — if you can get Nimbus to sign the one-page MOU and confirm the PO plan, I will escalate for the remaining $3k needed to reach $8k. Otherwise we should proceed with the $5k/6-week baseline.

Laura

All —

After reviewing the ask and the projected ARR, I’m comfortable approving this as an exception under the following hard conditions (one-time exception approved):

1) Credits: one-time $8,000 free credit top-up applied to the Nimbus trial account; credits expire at the end of the pilot period.
2) Duration: 8-week evaluation window (start date to be agreed and logged in HubSpot).
3) Governance: two mandatory check-ins (week 2 and week 6) with CS + product to validate signal and to decide on conversion roadmap.
4) Documentation: Ben to upload signed one-page MOU to the Deal record (DEAL-9876) and create an addendum in DocuSign covering data handling and liability.
5) Controls: implement a hard token cap tied to the $8k credit and enable automated alerting to both Ben and CS when usage hits 75% of the cap.
6) Procurement: require PO for any billed integration work; no invoicing of professional services until PO received.

Ben — this approval is my sign-off. Please: 1) update HubSpot (link above), 2) request DocuSign MOU to be sent to Sara Gomez and Alex Rivera, 3) set calendar invites for the two check-ins, and 4) confirm once credits are applied so Finance can code the promotional expense.

I’ll mark this as an exception and add internal notes. Thanks for moving fast on this — good opportunity for a foothold in healthcare.

Karthik Iyer | Head, Sales Ops & PLG Growth
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
